answer: Require every new agent to lock a 12 POA deposit for 6 epochs and to pass a proof-of-uptime check: answer three random pings per epoch within 90 seconds, drawn from a public schedule only revealed 60 seconds before. A farm running 100 clones must hold 1,200 POA and keep 300 live responders, so the anchor cost grows linearly. Failing two pings forfeits half the deposit, and the fable of cheap clones ends at the forge of real capital.
